chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from someone else, from Aban ibn Ziyad, from Aban ibn Uthman who said:

Ja'far (peace be upon him) called me and said: 'Did so-and-so sell his land?' I said, 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is written in the Torah that whoever sells land or water and does not place it in land or water, its price goes away with annihilation.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the value of sold land or water to remain intact according to the Torah?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) cites a ruling from the Torah regarding the sale of land or water. The key condition is that the proceeds must be reinvested into similar productive assets (land or water); otherwise, the value of the sale is lost due to 'annihilation' (fading away or loss of blessing).
